theorems

(* Theorems.words256E *)
lemma words256E: Theorems.words256 = State.h256.

(* Theorems.words512E *)
lemma words512E: Theorems.words512 = State.h512.

(* Theorems.sha256_stateE *)
lemma sha256_stateE:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (m : Bytes.bytes) (h : BArray32.t)
    (buf : BArray64.t) (total : JWord.W64.t),
    Theorems.sha256_state h0 m h buf total <=>
    SHA256_Stream.stream256 h0 m h buf total.

(* Theorems.sha512_stateE *)
lemma sha512_stateE:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W64.t List.list) (m : Bytes.bytes) (h : BArray64.t)
    (buf : BArray128.t) (total : JWord.W64.t),
    Theorems.sha512_state h0 m h buf total <=>
    SHA512_Stream.stream512 h0 m h buf total.

(* Theorems.sha256_compress_total *)
lemma sha256_compress_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (blk : BArray64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._sha256_compress :
             Theorems.words256 h = h0 /\ block = blk ==>
             Theorems.words256 res.`1 =
             FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.compress h0
               (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.be32
                  (BitEncoding.BitChunking.chunk 4 (BArray64.to_list blk)))] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha256_compress_blocks_total *)
lemma sha256_compress_blocks_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (p0 n0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._sha256_compress_blocks :
             Theorems.words256 h = h0 /\
             p = p0 /\
             n = n0 /\
             Int.(<)
               (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint p0)
                  (Int.( * ) 64 (JWord.W64.to_uint n0)))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus ==>
             Theorems.words256 res.`1 =
             List.foldl FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.compress h0
               (FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.parse
                  (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (JWord.W64.to_uint p0)
                     (Int.( * ) 64 (JWord.W64.to_uint n0))))] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha512_compress_total *)
lemma sha512_compress_total:

(* Theorems.sha256_absorb_mem_total *)
lemma sha256_absorb_mem_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (m : Bytes.bytes) (p0
    l0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._sha256_absorb_mem :
             Theorems.sha256_state h0 m h buf total /\
             in_0 = p0 /\
             inlen = l0 /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (List.size m) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus ==>
             Theorems.sha256_state h0
               (List.(++) m
                  (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (JWord.W64.to_uint p0)
                     (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))) res.`1 res.`2 res.`3] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

lemma sha256_finalize_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (m : Bytes.bytes),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._sha256___sha256_finalize :

             List.take 32

(* Theorems.hmac_sha256_keyblock_total *)
lemma hmac_sha256_keyblock_total:
  forall (p0 l0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._hmac_sha256_keyblock_mem :
             key = p0 /\
             keylen = l0 /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus /\
             Int.(<) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) ==>
             BArray64.to_list res.`1 =
             FIPS198_HMAC.hmac_key FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.sha256 64
               (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (JWord.W64.to_uint p0)
                  (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.hmac_sha512_keyblock_total *)
lemma hmac_sha512_keyblock_total:
  forall (p0 l0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._hmac_sha512_keyblock_mem :
             key = p0 /\
             keylen = l0 /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus /\
             Int.(<) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) ==>
             BArray128.to_list res.`1 =
             FIPS198_HMAC.hmac_key FIPS180_SHA2.SHA512.sha512 128
               (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (JWord.W64.to_uint p0)
                  (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.hmac_sha256_mem_total *)
lemma hmac_sha256_mem_total:
  forall (pk lk pm lm : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._hmac_sha256_mem :
             key = pk /\
             keylen = lk /\
             msg = pm /\
             msglen = lm /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint pk) (JWord.W64.to_uint lk))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus /\
             Int.(<) (JWord.W64.to_uint lk) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint pm) (JWord.W64.to_uint lm))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) 64 (JWord.W64.to_uint lm))
               (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) ==>
             BArray32.to_list res.`1 =
             FIPS198_HMAC.hmac_sha256
               (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (JWord.W64.to_uint pk)
                  (JWord.W64.to_uint lk))
               (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (JWord.W64.to_uint pm)
                  (JWord.W64.to_uint lm))] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.hmac_sha512_mem_total *)
lemma hmac_sha512_mem_total:
  forall (pk lk pm lm : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._hmac_sha512_mem :
             key = pk /\
             keylen = lk /\
             msg = pm /\
             msglen = lm /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint pk) (JWord.W64.to_uint lk))

             Int.(<) (JWord.W64.to_uint lk) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) /\

                  (JWord.W64.to_uint lk))
               (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (JWord.W64.to_uint pm)

    Theorems.sha256_ctx tag h0 m c <=> Ctx256.ctx256 tag h0 m c.

    Theorems.sha512_ctx tag h0 m c <=> Ctx512.ctx512 tag h0 m c.

lemma hmac256_tagE: Theorems.hmac256_tag = CtxHmac256.tag256h.

(* Theorems.hmac512_tagE *)
lemma hmac512_tagE: Theorems.hmac512_tag = CtxHmac512.tag512h.

(* Theorems.sha256_ctx_init_total *)
lemma sha256_ctx_init_total:
  forall (h1 : BArray32.t) (t : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.__sha256_ctx_init :
             h = h1 /\ tag = t /\ total = JWord.W64.zero ==>
             Theorems.sha256_ctx t (Theorems.words256 h1) [] res] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha256_ctx_update_total *)
lemma sha256_ctx_update_total:
  forall (c0 : BArray112.t) (tag0 : JWord.W64.t) (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list)
    (m : Bytes.bytes) (p0 l0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._sha256_ctx_update :
             ctx = c0 /\
             in_0 = p0 /\
             inlen = l0 /\
             expect_0 = tag0 /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus ==>
             (res.`2 <> JWord.W64.zero => res.`1 = c0) /\
             (BArray112.get64d c0 0 <> tag0 => res.`2 = JWord.W64.one) /\
             (Theorems.sha256_ctx tag0 h0 m c0 =>
              if Int.(<) (Int.(+) (List.size m) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
                   (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) then
                res.`2 = JWord.W64.zero /\
                Theorems.sha256_ctx tag0 h0
                  (List.(++) m
                     (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem
                        (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0)))
                  res.`1
              else res.`2 = JWord.W64.of_int 2)] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha224_ctx_final_total *)
lemma sha224_ctx_final_total:
  forall (c0 : BArray112.t) (tag0 : JWord.W64.t) (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list)
    (m : Bytes.bytes) (d0 : BArray28.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._sha224_ctx___sha2_ctx_final :
             ctx = c0 /\ digest = d0 /\ expect_0 = tag0 ==>
             (BArray112.get64d c0 0 <> tag0 =>
              res.`3 = JWord.W64.one /\ res.`1 = c0 /\ res.`2 = d0) /\
             (Theorems.sha256_ctx tag0 h0 m c0 =>
              res.`3 = JWord.W64.zero /\
              BArray28.to_list res.`2 =
              List.take 28
                (List.flatten
                   (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.w32_be
                      (FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.hash h0 m))) /\
              forall (i : int),
                0 Int.(<=) i Int.(<) 112 => res.`1.[i] = JWord.W8.zero)] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.lane256E *)
lemma lane256E:
  forall (h : BArray256.t) (k : int), Theorems.lane256 h k = SHA256_X8.l8 h k.

(* Theorems.lane512E *)
lemma lane512E:
  forall (h : BArray256.t) (k : int), Theorems.lane512 h k = SHA512_X4.l4 h k.

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_stateE *)
lemma sha256_x8_stateE:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (ms : int -> Bytes.bytes)
    (h : BArray256.t) (buf : BArray512.t) (total : JWord.W64.t),
    Theorems.sha256_x8_state h0 ms h buf total <=>
    SHA256_X8.stream8 h0 ms h buf total.

(* Theorems.sha512_x4_stateE *)
lemma sha512_x4_stateE:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W64.t List.list) (ms : int -> Bytes.bytes)
    (h : BArray256.t) (buf : BArray512.t) (total : JWord.W64.t),
    Theorems.sha512_x4_state h0 ms h buf total <=>
    SHA512_X4.stream4 h0 ms h buf total.

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_ctxE *)
lemma sha256_x8_ctxE:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (ms : int -> Bytes.bytes)
    (c : BArray784.t), Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx h0 ms c <=> CtxX8.ctx8 h0 ms c.

(* Theorems.sha512_x4_ctxE *)
lemma sha512_x4_ctxE:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W64.t List.list) (ms : int -> Bytes.bytes)
    (c : BArray784.t), Theorems.sha512_x4_ctx h0 ms c <=> CtxX4.ctx4 h0 ms c.

(* Theorems.sha2_tagE *)
lemma sha2_tagE:
  forall (f : int),
    Theorems.sha2_tag f =
    JWord.W64.of_int (Int.(+) 1100357333870 (JUtils.(`<<`) f 32)).

(* Theorems.tag2E *)
lemma tag2E: Theorems.sha2_tag 2 = CtxX8.tag256.

(* Theorems.tag9E *)
lemma tag9E: Theorems.sha2_tag 9 = CtxX8.tagx8.

(* Theorems.tag4E *)
lemma tag4E: Theorems.sha2_tag 4 = CtxX4.tag512.

(* Theorems.tag10E *)
lemma tag10E: Theorems.sha2_tag 10 = CtxX4.tagx4.

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_init_total *)
lemma sha256_x8_init_total:
  phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.__sha256_x8_init :
           true ==>
           forall (k : int),
             0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 8 =>
             Theorems.lane256 res k = FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.H0_256] = (
  Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_from_total *)
lemma sha256_x8_from_total:
  forall (hs0 : BArray32.t) (bs0 : BArray64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.__sha256_x8_from :
             hs = hs0 /\ bs = bs0 ==>
             (forall (k : int),
                0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 8 =>
                Theorems.lane256 res.`1 k = Theorems.words256 hs0) /\
             forall (k : int),
               0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 8 => SHA256_X8.sub8 res.`2 k = bs0] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_absorb_total *)
lemma sha256_x8_absorb_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (ms0 : int -> Bytes.bytes)
    (in0 : BArray64.t) (l0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._sha256_x8_absorb_lanes :
             Theorems.sha256_x8_state h0 ms0 h buf total /\
             in_0 = in0 /\
             inlen = l0 /\
             (forall (q : int),
                0 Int.(<=) q Int.(<) 8 =>
                Int.(<)
                  (Int.(+) (SHA256_X8.ptr in0 q) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
                  JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus) /\
             Int.(<)
               (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint total) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus ==>
             Theorems.sha256_x8_state h0
               (fun (k : int) =>
                  List.(++) (ms0 k)
                    (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (SHA256_X8.ptr in0 k)
                       (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))) res.`1 res.`2 res.`3] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_finalize_total *)
lemma sha256_x8_finalize_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (ms0 : int -> Bytes.bytes),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._sha256_x8_finalize :
             Theorems.sha256_x8_state h0 ms0 h buf total /\
             Int.(<) (JWord.W64.to_uint total) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) ==>
             forall (k : int),
               0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 8 =>
               List.take 32
                 (List.drop (Int.( * ) 32 k) (BArray256.to_list res.`1)) =
               List.flatten
                 (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.w32_be
                    (FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.hash h0 (ms0 k)))] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_lanes_total *)
lemma sha256_x8_lanes_total:
  forall (in0 : BArray64.t) (l0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._sha256_x8_lanes :
             in_0 = in0 /\
             len = l0 /\
             (forall (q : int),
                0 Int.(<=) q Int.(<) 8 =>
                Int.(<)
                  (Int.(+) (SHA256_X8.ptr in0 q) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
                  JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus) /\
             Int.(<) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) ==>
             forall (k : int),
               0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 8 =>
               List.take 32
                 (List.drop (Int.( * ) 32 k) (BArray256.to_list res.`1)) =
               FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.sha256
                 (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (SHA256_X8.ptr in0 k)
                    (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx_init_total *)
lemma sha256_x8_ctx_init_total:
  phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.__sha256_x8_ctx_init :
           true ==>
           Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.H0_256
             (fun (_ : int) => []) res] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx_from_total *)
lemma sha256_x8_ctx_from_total:
  forall (c0 : BArray784.t) (s0 : BArray112.t) (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list)
    (m : Bytes.bytes),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._sha256_x8_ctx_from :
             ctx = c0 /\ src = s0 ==>
             (BArray112.get64d s0 0 <> Theorems.sha2_tag 2 =>
              res.`2 = JWord.W64.one /\ res.`1 = c0) /\
             (Theorems.sha256_ctx (Theorems.sha2_tag 2) h0 m s0 =>
              res.`2 = JWord.W64.zero /\
              Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx h0 (fun (_ : int) => m) res.`1)] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx_update_total *)
lemma sha256_x8_ctx_update_total:
  forall (c0 : BArray784.t) (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list)
    (ms0 : int -> Bytes.bytes) (in0 : BArray64.t) (l0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._sha256_x8_ctx_update :
             ctx = c0 /\
             in_0 = in0 /\
             inlen = l0 /\
             forall (q : int),
               0 Int.(<=) q Int.(<) 8 =>
               Int.(<) (Int.(+) (SHA256_X8.ptr in0 q) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
                 JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus ==>
             (res.`2 <> JWord.W64.zero => res.`1 = c0) /\
             (BArray784.get64d c0 0 <> Theorems.sha2_tag 9 =>
              res.`2 = JWord.W64.one) /\
             (Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx h0 ms0 c0 =>
              if Int.(<) (Int.(+) (List.size (ms0 0)) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
                   (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) then
                res.`2 = JWord.W64.zero /\
                Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx h0
                  (fun (k : int) =>
                     List.(++) (ms0 k)
                       (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem
                          (SHA256_X8.ptr in0 k) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0)))
                  res.`1
              else res.`2 = JWord.W64.of_int 2)] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx_final_total *)
lemma sha256_x8_ctx_final_total:
  forall (c0 : BArray784.t) (d0 : BArray256.t) (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list)
    (ms0 : int -> Bytes.bytes),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._sha256_x8_ctx_final :
             ctx = c0 /\ out = d0 ==>
             (BArray784.get64d c0 0 <> Theorems.sha2_tag 9 =>
              res.`3 = JWord.W64.one /\ res.`1 = c0 /\ res.`2 = d0) /\
             (Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx h0 ms0 c0 =>
              res.`3 = JWord.W64.zero /\
              (forall (k : int),
                 0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 8 =>
                 List.take 32
                   (List.drop (Int.( * ) 32 k) (BArray256.to_list res.`2)) =
                 List.flatten
                   (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.w32_be
                      (FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.hash h0 (ms0 k)))) /\
              forall (i : int),
                0 Int.(<=) i Int.(<) 784 => res.`1.[i] = JWord.W8.zero)] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

           true ==>
           forall (k : int),
             0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 4 =>
             Theorems.lane512 res k = FIPS180_SHA2.SHA512.H0_512] = (
  Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha512_x4_from_total *)
lemma sha512_x4_from_total:
  forall (hs0 : BArray64.t) (bs0 : BArray128.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.__sha512_x4_from :
             hs = hs0 /\ bs = bs0 ==>
             (forall (k : int),
                0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 4 =>
                Theorems.lane512 res.`1 k = Theorems.words512 hs0) /\
             forall (k : int),
               0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 4 => SHA512_X4.sub4 res.`2 k = bs0] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha512_x4_absorb_total *)
lemma sha512_x4_absorb_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W64.t List.list) (ms0 : int -> Bytes.bytes)
    (in0 : BArray32.t) (l0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._sha512_x4_absorb_lanes :
             Theorems.sha512_x4_state h0 ms0 h buf total /\
             in_0 = in0 /\
             inlen = l0 /\
             (forall (q : int),
                0 Int.(<=) q Int.(<) 4 =>
                Int.(<)
                  (Int.(+) (SHA512_X4.ptr in0 q) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
                  JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus) /\
             Int.(<)
               (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint total) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus ==>
             Theorems.sha512_x4_state h0
               (fun (k : int) =>
                  List.(++) (ms0 k)
                    (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (SHA512_X4.ptr in0 k)
                       (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))) res.`1 res.`2 res.`3] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha512_x4_finalize_total *)
lemma sha512_x4_finalize_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W64.t List.list) (ms0 : int -> Bytes.bytes),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M._sha512_x4_finalize :
             Theorems.sha512_x4_state h0 ms0 h buf total /\
             Int.(<) (JWord.W64.to_uint total) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) ==>
             forall (k : int),
               0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 4 =>
               List.take 64
                 (List.drop (Int.( * ) 64 k) (BArray256.to_list res.`1)) =
               List.flatten
                 (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.w64_be
                    (FIPS180_SHA2.SHA512.hash h0 (ms0 k)))] = (Real.(%r) 1).

               FIPS180_SHA2.SHA512.sha512
                 (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (SHA512_X4.ptr in0 k)
                    (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))] = (Real.(%r) 1).

  forall (c0 : BArray112.t) (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (m : Bytes.bytes)
    (p0 l0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.sha224_update :
             ctx = c0 /\
             in_0 = p0 /\
             inlen = l0 /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus ==>
             (res.`2 <> JWord.W64.zero => res.`1 = c0) /\
             (BArray112.get64d c0 0 <> Theorems.sha2_tag 1 =>
              res.`2 = JWord.W64.one) /\
             (Theorems.sha256_ctx (Theorems.sha2_tag 1) h0 m c0 =>
              if Int.(<) (Int.(+) (List.size m) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
                   (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) then
                res.`2 = JWord.W64.zero /\
                Theorems.sha256_ctx (Theorems.sha2_tag 1) h0
                  (List.(++) m
                     (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem
                        (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0)))
                  res.`1
              else res.`2 = JWord.W64.of_int 2)] = (Real.(%r) 1).

             inlen = l0 /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus ==>
             (res.`2 <> JWord.W64.zero => res.`1 = c0) /\
             (BArray208.get64d c0 0 <> Theorems.sha2_tag 4 =>
              res.`2 = JWord.W64.one) /\
             (Theorems.sha512_ctx (Theorems.sha2_tag 4) h0 m c0 =>
              if Int.(<) (Int.(+) (List.size m) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
                   (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) then
                res.`2 = JWord.W64.zero /\
                Theorems.sha512_ctx (Theorems.sha2_tag 4) h0
                  (List.(++) m
                     (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem
                        (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0)))
                  res.`1
              else res.`2 = JWord.W64.of_int 2)] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha512_final_export_total *)
lemma sha512_final_export_total:
  forall (c0 : BArray208.t) (h0 : JWord.W64.t List.list) (m : Bytes.bytes)
    (d0 : BArray64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.sha512_final :
             ctx = c0 /\ out = d0 ==>
             (BArray208.get64d c0 0 <> Theorems.sha2_tag 4 =>
              res.`3 = JWord.W64.one /\ res.`1 = c0 /\ res.`2 = d0) /\
             (Theorems.sha512_ctx (Theorems.sha2_tag 4) h0 m c0 =>
              res.`3 = JWord.W64.zero /\
              BArray64.to_list res.`2 =
              List.take 64
                (List.flatten
                   (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.w64_be
                      (FIPS180_SHA2.SHA512.hash h0 m))) /\
              forall (i : int),
                0 Int.(<=) i Int.(<) 208 => res.`1.[i] = JWord.W8.zero)] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.hmac_sha256_export_total *)
lemma hmac_sha256_export_total:
  forall (pk lk pm lm : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.hmac_sha256 :
             key = pk /\
             keylen = lk /\
             msg = pm /\
             msglen = lm /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint pk) (JWord.W64.to_uint lk))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus /\
             Int.(<) (JWord.W64.to_uint lk) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint pm) (JWord.W64.to_uint lm))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) 64 (JWord.W64.to_uint lm))
               (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) ==>
             BArray32.to_list res =
             FIPS198_HMAC.hmac_sha256
               (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (JWord.W64.to_uint pk)
                  (JWord.W64.to_uint lk))
               (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (JWord.W64.to_uint pm)
                  (JWord.W64.to_uint lm))] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.hmac_sha256_init_export_total *)
lemma hmac_sha256_init_export_total:
  forall (pk lk : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.hmac_sha256_init :
             key = pk /\
             keylen = lk /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint pk) (JWord.W64.to_uint lk))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus /\
             Int.(<) (JWord.W64.to_uint lk) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) ==>
             Theorems.hmac256_ctx Theorems.hmac256_tag
               (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (JWord.W64.to_uint pk)
                  (JWord.W64.to_uint lk)) [] res] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.hmac_sha256_update_export_total *)
lemma hmac_sha256_update_export_total:
  forall (c0 : BArray144.t) (k text : Bytes.bytes) (p0 l0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.hmac_sha256_update :
             ctx = c0 /\
             in_0 = p0 /\
             inlen = l0 /\
             Int.(<) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
               JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus ==>
             (res.`2 <> JWord.W64.zero => res.`1 = c0) /\
             (BArray112.get64d (SBArray144_112.SBArray144_112.get_sub c0 0) 0 <>
              Theorems.hmac256_tag => res.`2 = JWord.W64.one) /\
             (Theorems.hmac256_ctx Theorems.hmac256_tag k text c0 =>
              if Int.(<) (Int.(+) (List.size text) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
                   (Int.(-) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) 64) then
                res.`2 = JWord.W64.zero /\
                Theorems.hmac256_ctx Theorems.hmac256_tag k
                  (List.(++) text
                     (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem
                        (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0)))
                  res.`1
              else res.`2 = JWord.W64.of_int 2)] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.hmac_sha256_final_export_total *)
lemma hmac_sha256_final_export_total:
  forall (c0 : BArray144.t) (o0 : BArray32.t) (k text : Bytes.bytes),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.hmac_sha256_final :
             ctx = c0 /\ out = o0 ==>
             (BArray112.get64d (SBArray144_112.SBArray144_112.get_sub c0 0) 0 <>
              Theorems.hmac256_tag =>
              res.`3 = JWord.W64.one /\ res.`1 = c0 /\ res.`2 = o0) /\
             (Theorems.hmac256_ctx Theorems.hmac256_tag k text c0 =>
              res.`3 = JWord.W64.zero /\
              BArray32.to_list res.`2 = FIPS198_HMAC.hmac_sha256 k text /\
              forall (i : int),
                0 Int.(<=) i Int.(<) 144 => res.`1.[i] = JWord.W8.zero)] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_export_total *)
lemma sha256_x8_export_total:
  forall (in0 : BArray64.t) (l0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.sha256_x8 :
             in_0 = in0 /\
             len = l0 /\
             (forall (q : int),
                0 Int.(<=) q Int.(<) 8 =>
                Int.(<)
                  (Int.(+) (SHA256_X8.ptr in0 q) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
                  JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus) /\
             Int.(<) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) ==>
             forall (k : int),
               0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 8 =>
               List.take 32
                 (List.drop (Int.( * ) 32 k) (BArray256.to_list res)) =
               FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.sha256
                 (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem (SHA256_X8.ptr in0 k)
                    (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))] = (Real.(%r) 1).

lemma sha256_x8_init_export_total:
  phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.sha256_x8_init :
           true ==>
           Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.H0_256
             (fun (_ : int) => []) res] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_init_from_export_total *)
lemma sha256_x8_init_from_export_total:

    (m : Bytes.bytes),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.sha256_x8_init_from :
             ctx = c0 /\ src = s0 ==>
             (BArray112.get64d s0 0 <> Theorems.sha2_tag 2 =>
              res.`2 = JWord.W64.one /\ res.`1 = c0) /\
             (Theorems.sha256_ctx (Theorems.sha2_tag 2) h0 m s0 =>
              res.`2 = JWord.W64.zero /\
              Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx h0 (fun (_ : int) => m) res.`1)] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_update_export_total *)
lemma sha256_x8_update_export_total:
  forall (c0 : BArray784.t) (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list)
    (ms0 : int -> Bytes.bytes) (in0 : BArray64.t) (l0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.sha256_x8_update :
             ctx = c0 /\
             in_0 = in0 /\
             inlen = l0 /\
             forall (q : int),
               0 Int.(<=) q Int.(<) 8 =>
               Int.(<) (Int.(+) (SHA256_X8.ptr in0 q) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
                 JModel_armv8a.ptr_modulus ==>
             (res.`2 <> JWord.W64.zero => res.`1 = c0) /\
             (BArray784.get64d c0 0 <> Theorems.sha2_tag 9 =>
              res.`2 = JWord.W64.one) /\
             (Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx h0 ms0 c0 =>
              if Int.(<) (Int.(+) (List.size (ms0 0)) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
                   (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 61) then
                res.`2 = JWord.W64.zero /\
                Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx h0
                  (fun (k : int) =>
                     List.(++) (ms0 k)
                       (Theorems.memread JMemory.Glob.mem
                          (SHA256_X8.ptr in0 k) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0)))
                  res.`1
              else res.`2 = JWord.W64.of_int 2)] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* Theorems.sha256_x8_final_export_total *)
lemma sha256_x8_final_export_total:

             ctx = c0 /\ out = d0 ==>

             (Theorems.sha256_x8_ctx h0 ms0 c0 =>
              res.`3 = JWord.W64.zero /\

                 0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 8 =>
                 List.take 32

                 List.flatten
                   (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.w32_be
                      (FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.hash h0 (ms0 k)))) /\
              forall (i : int),
                0 Int.(<=) i Int.(<) 784 => res.`1.[i] = JWord.W8.zero)] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

lemma sha512_x4_final_export_total:
  forall (c0 : BArray784.t) (d0 : BArray256.t) (h0 : JWord.W64.t List.list)
    (ms0 : int -> Bytes.bytes),
    phoare[ NirapodSha2.M.sha512_x4_final :
             ctx = c0 /\ out = d0 ==>
             (BArray784.get64d c0 0 <> Theorems.sha2_tag 10 =>
              res.`3 = JWord.W64.one /\ res.`1 = c0 /\ res.`2 = d0) /\
             (Theorems.sha512_x4_ctx h0 ms0 c0 =>
              res.`3 = JWord.W64.zero /\
              (forall (k : int),
                 0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 4 =>
                 List.take 64
                   (List.drop (Int.( * ) 64 k) (BArray256.to_list res.`2)) =
                 List.flatten
                   (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.w64_be
                      (FIPS180_SHA2.SHA512.hash h0 (ms0 k)))) /\
              forall (i : int),
                0 Int.(<=) i Int.(<) 784 => res.`1.[i] = JWord.W8.zero)] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* ArrayInst.a1_fill64_array_total *)
lemma a1_fill64_array_total:
  forall (b0 : BArray64.t) (a0 : BArray1.t) (d0 o0 n0 : JWord.W64.t),
    phoare[ ArraySha2.M.a1____fill64_array :
             buf = b0 /\
             a = a0 /\
             dst_ = d0 /\
             off_ = o0 /\
             n_ = n0 /\
             Int.(<=) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint d0) (JWord.W64.to_uint n0))
               64 /\
             Int.(<=) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint o0) (JWord.W64.to_uint n0))
               1 ==>
             forall (i : int),
               0 Int.(<=) i Int.(<) 64 =>
               res.`1.[i] =
               if JWord.W64.to_uint d0 Int.(<=) i Int.(<)
                  Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint d0) (JWord.W64.to_uint n0) then
                 a0.[Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint o0)
                       (Int.(-) i (JWord.W64.to_uint d0))]
               else b0.[i]] = (Real.(%r) 1).
